about: M5 of docs/world-detail-plan.md: smoke out of the roof holes over two burning hearths, two braziers along the way to the ship. Layer and own PFX: scripts/content/harbour_motion.py layer. Positions in Gothic cm; offsets of a brazier's fire, smoke and light in its own axes, as the original braziers (OC_LOB_LIGHTER_HUGE3 by the fishers and the mole). Hut smoke drifts with the world wind (+z) through its own flyGravity; its sprite OWN_HUT_SMOKE comes from content/materials (harbour_motion.py texture).

particles.name: OWN_HUT_SMOKE_04
particles.why: Smoke of a hut fired without a chimney, from the hole in its roof: a veil, not a column (reports/Дым очага в игровом мире.md; reports/content/remaster/harbour-motion/README.md, r5). One source as large as the hole, a static soft sprite OWN_HUT_SMOKE (content/materials, made from the base by harbour_motion.py texture), warm grey 75 that is a little darker than the noon sky and lighter than the crowns; 8 particles/s at alpha 104, about four times the optical depth of the card's veil (r7 d4: it reads by day, a third of the background covered, no column, no glow at night), 0.75 m/s up, a cone of 10 deg, 10 s, drifting with the wind through flyGravity along +z; the rate breathes over 24 s.

particles.name: OWN_HUT_SMOKE_06
particles.why: The same smoke over the smaller hole of HAFEN06, its rate breathing in another phase.
